description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.19.3 is a feature release for macOS, Windows and Linux on top of 0.19.2.
New
- Chats follow the missions they start. When an agent in a chat starts a mission, Runner links the mission to that chat and types a short [runner] line into it when the mission needs you, fails or settles, so the agent no longer has to watch the mission's feed. The sidebar groups linked missions under their chat in Projects and Active; drag a mission onto a chat to link it, or out of the group to unlink it. From the CLI, runner mission link and runner mission unlink change the link, and runner mission start --no-report links without the reports. (#748)
- Use any installed monospace font in the terminal. Settings → Terminal → Font family is now a searchable list of the bundled font and every monospace font installed on your computer. A saved SF Mono, Fira Code or Monaco now loads as that font instead of Menlo. If a chosen font is uninstalled, the terminal falls back to the bundled font and the setting shows it as Not installed. (#931)
Bug fixes
- An agent's runner commands reach the Runner that started it. If your shell's startup files put another Runner build's runner first on the PATH, as some agent installers do, an agent such as Codex could send its commands to that build: a development build's chat started missions in the installed Runner. Commands now always reach the Runner that spawned the session. (#1149)
- Claude Code chats and missions in a new folder no longer stop at the folder-trust prompt. Runner now records the folder as trusted for the account the session uses before Claude Code starts, so a mission's goal is delivered without anyone accepting the prompt. (#1067)
- Runner no longer quits at launch when runnerd drops while the first window opens. The window opens anyway and registers with runnerd when it reconnects. (#1115)
- The new-tab launcher can be closed after you close the active tab. Its ×, the sidebar row's ×, ⌘W and Esc were unavailable while other tabs were still open; they now return to the tab you viewed most recently. (#1146)
- Changing a role's runtime keeps its permission mode. runner role update <role> --runtime <runtime> left the old runtime's permission flags in the role, so every chat from it stopped at once with "The PTY exited with code 1". The flags are now rewritten for the new runtime, and runner role update <role> --permission <mode> repairs a role that was already affected. (#1155)
- A Windows computer reliably saves paired devices in Remote access. A device's kind and last-seen time could stay unsaved while another program, such as a virus scanner, held the file open. (#1143)
